page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no bundled local storage, and the instance does not include any GPU hardware. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but lower multi-core and memory throughput. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng scores 1855.08, and the Geekbench single-core score is 1553.0, both falling into average tiers. However, multi-core benchmarks are weak, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 1896.44 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 1808.0. Memory bandwidth is also limited, measuring 14.09 GB/sec for large block reads and 12.92 GB/sec for large block writes. Cryptographic and compression tasks show moderate performance, with single-threaded gzip compression reaching 28.03 GB/sec.

The primary trade-off of the ecs.g7t.large is its low multi-core scaling and constrained memory bandwidth, which limits its utility for parallel processing or memory-intensive databases. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable single-threaded performance for entry-level workloads without the risk of CPU credit exhaustion. This instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic web serving, text processing, and small-scale development or testing environments that do not require high multi-core throughput or local storage.
